newsitem.title: USA: Transamerica Corp Q3 shr $1.67 vs $2.08.
newsitem.headline: Transamerica Corp Q3 shr $1.67 vs $2.08.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

Note - Q3 1996 net includes $0.01 per share benefit from special items in the third quarter of 1996, $63.8 million from the resolution of prior years' tax matters and $9.1 million from the elimination of contingencies associated with the year-ago sale of assets in Puerto Rico by the commercial lending operations, as well as other matters. Offsetting these benefits was a $72 million after-tax charge at Transamerica's consumer lending operations primarily for increased loss reserves.

Q3 1995 net income included a net benefit of $0.17 per share, or $11.4 million, from special items, $32.9 million of net benefits, principally from the resolution of prior years' tax issues, partially offset by a $21.5 million after-tax writedown of Transamerica Center in Los Angeles.
1996 nine months net before investment gains was $4.55 a share vs $4.56 in the year-ago period.
